title: BPBD/Pusdalops historical impact-source qualification and acquisition gate
research_question: Do 2014-2017 BPBD/Pusdalops materials provide a sufficiently traceable local victim/physical-impact source for source-native acquisition or independent reconciliation against BNPB/DIBI?

bpbd_2015.interpretation_rule: Use explicit table/graph labels to retain the 2015 report-year assignment while preserving the conflicting 2014 narrative sentence as a quality flag; do not silently erase the contradiction.

bpbd_2017.official_ppid_title: Laporan Tahunan Data Kebencanaan Pusdalops PB Sumatera Barat Tahun 2017
bpbd_2017.indexed_event_counting_description: same event on same date counted once; detailed geography, impact and loss accumulated for the event

claim_boundaries: The explicit 2015 table and graph support retaining 686 as a 2015 local operational count, but the report's conflicting 2014 narrative sentence remains a source-quality flag.
The 2015 report explicitly warns that the 2015 district/city recap was incomplete as of January 2016 and should be revised when additional reports arrive.
PPID record 8604 proves the 2017 annual report exists in the official archive; it does not provide the raw report bytes in this milestone.
The indexed 2017 mirror establishes a plausible impact-capable schema and verification targets, not an authoritative raw observation snapshot.
No local BPBD victim, damage, event or loss value is inserted into the canonical BNPB/DIBI panel by M50.

next_gate.title: BPBD 2017 raw artifact acquisition and source-native extraction
tasks: Obtain the official raw 2017 Pusdalops annual report from PPID/BPBD or another government-hosted archival surface.
Freeze raw bytes, checksum, page/table locators and extraction provenance before ingesting any values.
Compare raw 2017 values against the indexed expected values and record every disagreement rather than correcting either source silently.
If raw acquisition succeeds, materialize a separate BPBD source-native impact layer; keep BNPB/DIBI reconciliation blocked until taxonomy, independence and metric semantics are qualified.
